responsibility: Render truthful low-power, thermal, model-degradation and L1-L4 status/recovery presentations without owning retry or recovery policy

inputs.runtimeCondition: Live low-power, thermal and model availability values from adapters
inputs.errorPresentation: Mapped L1-L4 UI state and permitted recovery actions
inputs.backgroundTaskPreference: User preference controlling low-power background task behavior

outputs.visibleContent: Shared banner, blocking recovery or conflict presentation appropriate to the mapped severity
outputs.interactionTargets: Dismiss, retry, open settings, toggle background tasks and resolve conflict
outputs.accessibilityTree: Status announcement with severity, consequence and available recovery action

systemContainer: Banner overlay + full-screen blocking recovery + conflict sheet
fallbackConditions: Masonry is always forbidden for this Task surface
L3 uses a blocking recovery surface and L4 exposes the conflict-resolution entry rather than compressing either into a transient banner
description: Displays non-intrusive degradation banners when device conditions (low power, thermal pressure, model load failure) require reduced functionality. Auto-dismisses when conditions normalize. Per echo-memory-canvas-style §11.4.

stateDetails.description: Low power mode enabled. Banner shows battery warning + optional background task pause toggle.
Device thermal state .serious or above. Banner shows temperature warning.
Core ML model failed to load. Banner shows model error + retry button.
L1 transient error: automatic exponential-backoff retry in progress (AGENTS.md §4.4).
L2 recoverable error: manual retry via PendingOperations.
L3 blocking error: feature stopped; guides to system settings repair.
L4 data conflict: manual merge UI required.

actions.description: User dismisses a banner (available for all degradation types)
User taps retry on model degradation banner
User toggles 'pause background tasks during low power' setting
User taps settings button to navigate to relevant settings section
L2 manual retry of a pending operation
L3 navigate to system settings repair

journeys.description: Full lifecycle: normal → lowPower → thermal → modelDegraded → normal recovery
Error escalation: L1 transient → L2 recoverable → L3 blocking → L4 conflict resolution
